PIPELINE STAGE: 06 / Aim 2: Cross-Tissue Ageing Biology - part 10 of 10
=================================================================
Assembles the final manuscript figures 1-5 (clock performance, delta-age, tissue-specific CpG methylation, overlapping-CpG methylation, system-level divergence) and supplementary figures 1-3.

Depends on objects created by part 9 (09_regulatory_regions_analysis.Rmd) having already been run in the same R
session (or knitted first, with its environment preserved) - this file does not reload raw data from scratch.
=================================================================
-->

```{r config_part10}
# Set the root directory of this project (edit here, or export
# EPICLOCK_ROOT before running).
PROJECT_ROOT <- Sys.getenv("EPICLOCK_ROOT", unset = normalizePath("."))
```

# Final manuscript figures 

## Making_final_directory
```{r}

dir.create(here("results/final_maniscript_figures/"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

```

## Figure 1
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggplotify)
})
# ==========================
# MAIN FIGURE 1: Epigenetic Clock Performance
# ==========================
# Panel A: Performance by organs
# Panel B: Performance by CpG grouping
main_fig1 <- (performance_organs |
  performance_cpg_grouping) + 
  plot_layout(axes="collect")+
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")
main_fig1

ggsave("results/final_maniscript_figures/Fig1_main_performance.png", main_fig1, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 400)
```

## Figure 2

```{r}
# ==========================
# MAIN FIGURE 2: Delta age
# ==========================
# Panel A: Delta age by organ
# Panel B: Delta age by organ × age
main_fig2 <- (delta_age_organs   + 
  (delta_age_organs_x_age + guides(colour="none", fill = "none")))  + 
  plot_layout(guides = "collect",
              axes="collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
main_fig2

ggsave("results/final_maniscript_figures/Fig2_main_delta_age.png", main_fig2, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 400)
```

## Figure 3

```{r}
# ==========================
# MAIN FIGURE 3: Organ-specific CpG methylation
# ==========================
# Panel A: Mean methylation by organ
# Panel B: Methylation drift
# Panel C: Stochastic drift
main_fig3 <- ( ((methylation_org_specific_organs | 
  methylation_drift_org_specific )+ guides(colour="none", fill = "none")) / 
 ( methylation_density_org_specific + guides(colour="none", fill = "none") | 
  stochastic_drift_org_specific + guides(colour="none", fill = "none")) ) +
  
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
main_fig3

ggsave("results/final_maniscript_figures/Fig3_main_org_specific.png", main_fig3, width = 13, height = 13, dpi = 400)
```

## Figure 4

```{r}
# ==========================
# MAIN FIGURE 4: Overlapping somatic CpGs
# ==========================
# Panel A: Heatmap rows CpGs × organ × age
# Panel B: Methylation drift
# PAnel C : Methyaltion density
# Panel E: Stochastic drift

p5<- as.ggplot(heatmap_overlap_soma)
p6 <- as.ggplot(summary_heatmap_overlap_soma)
pp <- (p5 | p6) +plot_layout(widths = c(1.3, 0.7))

main_fig4 <- ((( ((methylation_overlap_soma | 
  methylation_drift_overlap_soma)+ guides(colour="none", fill = "none")) / 
 ( methylation_density_overlap_soma + guides(colour="none", fill = "none") | 
  stochastic_drift_overlap_soma + guides(colour="none", fill = "none")) ) +  plot_layout(guides = "collect") )/p5 ) +
  
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.6,0.6,1.8))+
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
main_fig4


ggsave("results/final_maniscript_figures/Fig4_main_overlap_soma.png", main_fig4, width = 13, height = 17, dpi = 400)
```


## Figure 5

```{r}
# ==========================
# MAIN FIGURE 5: System-level divergence
# ==========================
# Panel A: PCA organ-level
# Panel B: Cross-tissue delta discordance
# Panel C: Entropy plot
main_fig5 <- pca_org_level+ guides(colour="none", fill = "none")  + 
  cross_tissue_delta+ guides(colour="none", fill = "none")  + 
  entropy_plot  +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect")+
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")&
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
main_fig5

ggsave("results/final_maniscript_figures/Fig5_main_system_level.png", main_fig5, width = 15, height = 8, dpi = 400)
```
